title: A Free API Broke Silently — The Paid Backup Hid It | vitalii.no
description:
How a free image provider failing 100% of the time stayed invisible for over ten days, because a paid fallback kept quietly covering every request.

my image_provider_usage logs showed free Cloudflare FLUX succeeding 0 out of however many attempts for more than 10 days straight. The cause: process-image was still sending width and height parameters that Cloudflare had rejected with an HTTP 400 since August 19th. Because the pipeline had paid fallbacks behind it, every single news image kept generating successfully — just silently through the path that costs money, while there was no way to know the free path was broken.

The fix starts with the actual bug: process-image now calls the free provider through the shared helper with a request shape it accepts. Then it goes further on a free-only rule — the entire paid fallback chain is deleted, not just patched around. The function dropped its paid image provider, its billed critic step, and its billed photo-edit path — 1,060 lines removed from that one function alone. If the free path fails now, the image is simply missing instead of quietly billed.

News images generate through exactly one free provider now, with no paid path left for a bug to hide behind. The next time a request shape gets rejected, it shows up immediately instead of a 10-day unnoticed bill.
